alias: Last Mile Solutions / Threeforce B.V. (technical platform prefix; not a single physical CPO)

evidence.finding: Last Mile Solutions states that Threeforce B.V. trades as Last Mile Solutions and provides technical/administrative services for multiple charge-point operators and charging-card providers; LMS explicitly states it is not the end-user's provider.
Service-provider identifiers explicitly map LAST MILE SOLUTIONS (GERMANY) to DE-LMS.
DE*LMS EVSE IDs are observed at a STAWAG Stadtwerke Aachen site, demonstrating that the DE*LMS identifier can coexist with a different physical/operator brand.
DE*LMS EVSE IDs are observed across multiple German municipal/physical operators; therefore no operator-wide tariff may be attached to the prefix itself.

pricing_policy.reason: DE*LMS is a CPMS/service-provider identifier spanning multiple operators and station tariffs. A single tariff would be an unsafe extrapolation.
pricing_policy.allowed_resolution: Resolve exact price per EVSE/site using primary CPO/QR/direct-payment data or AFIR/Mobilithek/DATEX II evidence; otherwise remain fail-closed for that EVSE.

next_action: Enumerate DE*LMS EVSEs by physical operator and resolve station-level prices where primary/public evidence exists.
